newsitem.title: USA: Images of Virgin Mary appear in Chicago home.
newsitem.headline: Images of Virgin Mary appear in Chicago home.

text.p: Believers flocked to a suburban bungalow on Thursday to see an image of the Virgin Mary cradling the baby Jesus in the front window and to view a paper portrait of Mary that appears to be crying oily tears.

The image in the window appears to be condensation on the storm window in the form of a haloed figure. That, and the weeping portrait, both appeared at Sam Najjar's home on May 10, the day before Mother's Day in the United States.
Bishop Demetri of the Antiochian Archdiocese, an Orthodox Catholic church, visited Najjar's Schiller Park one-story home earlier this week and declared the two events a miracle.

Bishop Demetri, of Toledo, Ohio, anointed onlookers with oil that had spilled from the family's paper portrait of Mary sitting just below the window. Church leaders said the miracle may be connected to the Miraculous Lady of Cicero, a weeping statue of Mary at an Orthodox church in the Chicago suburb of Cicero.
Candles and other icons left by believers decorated the home's tiny front lawn, and a steady stream of visitors lined up outside.
